title: R3.0C Checkpoint Evidence Manifest — schema
note: Format for governance/r3.0c/checkpoints/<CHECKPOINT_ID>.json. C0 establishes the schema and writes its own manifest as 'pending'; final PASS is expressed by the trusted-verification artifact bound to artifactBoundSha. The checkpoint manifest never self-asserts PASS — only the CI artifact does.

fieldNotes.baseSha: Commit SHA the checkpoint built from (= previous checkpoint's headSha after merge).
fieldNotes.headSha: Commit SHA at the head of the checkpoint PR.
fieldNotes.previousCheckpoint: Checkpoint ID that authorized the prior state, or null for C0.
fieldNotes.authorizedPaths: Exact repo-relative production paths newly authorized by this checkpoint.
fieldNotes.forbiddenCapabilities: Capabilities the checkpoint must NOT enable (cross-checked against state.json).
fieldNotes.tests: Per-file test result digest (e.g. trusted-verification test-manifest summary).
fieldNotes.workflowRunId: GitHub Actions run id of the trusted-verification gate.
fieldNotes.artifactId: Uploaded artifact id of the evidence bundle.
fieldNotes.artifactBoundSha: SHA the artifact's summary.json was bound to (must equal headSha).
fieldNotes.codexVerdict: Final Codex verdict object (verdict, rounds, findings, fixes).
fieldNotes.frozenDiff: Count of frozen-boundary diff entries (must be 0 unless this checkpoint is an explicitly authorized frozen-allow).
fieldNotes.productionDiff: R3.0C production diff count from check-r3-0c-guard.
fieldNotes.runtimeConsumerCount: Count of production modules that require contracts/r3.0c (or otherwise consume R3.0C surface) — gated by no-consumer validator.
fieldNotes.featureRegistryState: Snapshot describing whether the three deferred feature IDs are still deferred and whether any rendererAdapter is attached.
fieldNotes.packageVersion: Value of package.json version at headSha.
fieldNotes.createdAt: ISO timestamp of manifest creation. Pass via stable means (CI clock or git commit timestamp); do not rely on local Date.now().
fieldNotes.status: 'pending' before CI; 'candidate' once CI has been started for the head SHA; final PASS lives in the artifact, not here.
fieldNotes.governanceChanged: true iff this checkpoint modifies any file under governance/r3.0c/, scripts/check-r3-0c-*.js, scripts/check-r3-0c-guard.js, scripts/collect-evidence.js, or .github/workflows/ci.yml. Codex scope MUST include governance review when true.

statusAuthority: Only the trusted-verification artifact may report status PASS. A checkpoint manifest may carry status: 'PASS' only as a post-merge mirror of an artifact already bound to its headSha.
